description: This Java class, CustomAuthenticationProvider, extends Spring Security's DaoAuthenticationProvider to customize the authentication process. It overrides the authenticate method to include additional checks for whether a user account is locked, and if so, whether it should be unlocked based on time elapsed, throwing a LockedException with a custom message if the account remains locked.

classes.name: CustomAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: A custom authentication provider for Spring Security that adds logic to handle account locking and unlocking based on time conditions.

methods.name: CustomAuthenticationProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a UserService instance.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to insert additional user locking logic before proceeding with standard authentication.
